description: One data row of exec/scenario_summary.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

hidden.description: True when a privacy rule withheld at least one covered value of the row; empty values then mean withheld.

persons.description: Number of persons with a cap in the scenario.

persons_stopped.description: Persons whose position passed their cap.

scenario_id.description: Id of the shadow scenario from the policy.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

units.description: Number of units with an envelope in the scenario.

title: gold-dataset-exec-scenario_summary
x-cost-column-rule: The `*_excess` and `*_top_up_total` columns are what the scenario would have done; they are never spend.
x-grain: One row per scenario and month.
